description: Na₂VMnF₇ crystallizes in the trigonal P3₂ space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to seven F atoms to form distorted NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one MnF₆ octahedra, corners with two VF₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, edges with two VF₆ octahedra, and edges with two MnF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-68°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.74 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to seven F atoms to form distorted NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one MnF₆ octahedra, corners with two VF₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, edges with two VF₆ octahedra, and edges with two MnF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-68°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.73 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.72 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.90 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to six F atoms to form VF₆ octahedra that share corners with four MnF₆ octahedra, corners with two NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with two NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-47°. There is one shorter (1.98 Å) and five longer (1.99 Å) V-F bond lengths. In the second V site, V is bonded to six F atoms to form VF₆ octahedra that share corners with four MnF₆ octahedra, corners with two NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with two NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-48°. There are a spread of V-F bond distances ranging from 1.96-1.99 Å. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to six F atoms to form MnF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnF₆ octahedra, corners with four VF₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramid, and edges with two NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-50°. There are a spread of Mn-F bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.16 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to six F atoms to form MnF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnF₆ octahedra, corners with four VF₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramid, and edges with two NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-50°. There are a spread of Mn-F bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.15 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to three Na and one V atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₃V tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded to three Na and one V atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃V tetrahedra. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one Mn atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one V, and one Mn atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two Mn atoms. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Mn atoms. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one Mn atom. In the eighth F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one Mn atom. In the ninth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one V, and one Mn atom. In the tenth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one V, and one Mn atom. In the eleventh F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one V, and one Mn atom. In the twelfth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one V, and one Mn atom. In the thirteenth F site, F is bonded to three Na and one V atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃V tetrahedra. In the fourteenth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one V atom.
